description: This file is a PHP source script that provides a web interface for initiating and displaying diagnostics for two telephony lines in a network gateway device. It includes frontend components such as HTML and JavaScript for user interaction, and server communication via AJAX with PHP scripts to perform line diagnostics and update the interface.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the page with 'Gateway > Connection > MTA > Line Diagnostics' navigation highlight.
